sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-.8B-OptiQ-4bit Mixed-precision quantized with OptiQ — sensitivity-driven quantization for Apple Silicon This is a mixed-precision quantized version of Qwen/Qwen3.5-.8B in MLX format. Unlike uniform quantization (all layers at the same bit-width), OptiQ measures each layer's sensitivity and assigns optimal per-layer bit-widths, preserving model quality where it matters most. sources.snippet: A 4-bit mixed-precision MLX quant of Qwen/Qwen3.5-.8B. Per-layer bit-widths come from a KL-divergence sensitivity pass on a six-domain calibration mix (prose · reasoning · code · agent · tool-call · constraint-bearing instructions). Sensitive layers go to 8-bit; robust ones stay at 4-bit. The on-disk size is within ~5 % of a stock uniform 4-bit MLX quant.
